notes.title: Trasmoz Legends v0.9: The Final Pre-Launch Update
notes.notes:
🏰 Trasmoz Legends v0.9 The Final PreLaunch Update
The wait is almost over. After an enormous effort, Trasmoz Legends is now complete, polished, and ready to shine! This update is a milestone, not just for the game, but for everyone who believed in it from the start.
[hr][/hr]🔧 A better game in every way
If you played version 0.04, get ready: the final version feels like a whole new experience.
Over the past months, I’ve rebuilt, tuned, and refined the game until every pixel, frame, and mechanic clicked into place.

Here’s what’s new:
✅ NEW SYSTEMS
🏆 25 Steam Achievements
Meaningful and handcrafted, designed to reward mastery and discovery.

🌍 Online leaderboards
Compete globally in Family, Classic, Speedrun, and Endless modes.

📊 Final score screens
Improved scoring for both 1P and 2P, with extra co-op bonuses and rewards in bonus stages.

🔁 Endless Mode expanded
Now 15 levels deep, with scaling difficulty that ramps up like a true ‘80s arcade. How many ghosts will you outsmart? How long until Mutamin crushes you? This is where the real high-score battles begin.

🎯 Hundreds of gameplay refinements
From improved enemy AI to tighter controls.

For example: pumpkins no longer damage you when bouncing after being hit, fixing one of the biggest frustration points I saw during retro events. This is just one of many subtle changes designed to make the game fairer and more addictive.

🎨 Visual and audio polish
Pixel-perfect sprites, sharper feedback, cleaner transitions, and improved sound mix.

The result is a game that plays smoother, hits harder, and feels dangerously addictive, whether you’re a casual player or a high-score hunter.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050047/c8a0b84047376fcb69a5e12ba50f507ff5d5d51a.png"]
[hr][/hr]🕹️ The arcade cabinet is real!
One of the biggest dreams of this project has come true: the Trasmoz Legends arcade cabinet is now a fully functional, permanent machine at El Templo del Arcade (Madrid).

Built by Jacaba and Lolo with absolute craftsmanship, it’s the game’s ultimate form: CRT screen, arcade controls, and pure retro energy. If you’re in Madrid, you can play it right now, the way it was always meant to be played.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050047/8cec080cb9f63e447dc64ce7edb90bd42b334137.jpg"]


[hr][/hr]📖 The artbook goes into production
With the game complete and the arcade cabinet standing, we can finally move forward with the artbook, the true closing chapter of the Trasmoz trilogy.

This volume will include:

Early sketches and unused concepts

Alternate sprites and designs

All physical editions of the Trasmoz saga for ZX Spectrum & Amstrad CPC

The full story of the arcade cabinet

And much much more...

It’s a tribute to everything this project represents, designed with the same obsessive care that went into the game itself.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050047/3794dde1679cee30cd9e1680cbd9cb910559814a.gif"]
[hr][/hr]🎮 Console versions on the way!
Thanks to JanduSoft and the incredible work of Jandu, Javi, and Marc, Trasmoz Legends is coming to PS5, PS4, Xbox One, Xbox Series, and Nintendo Switch!

The ports are underway, and they’re looking amazing. If everything goes as planned, the game will launch on all platforms this autumn.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050047/e68ea3ce588abe358bafe557cbf686122caf1916.png"]
[hr][/hr]⏳ What’s next
Trasmoz Legends is finished, but this is just the beginning.

Backers and early buyers on itch.io will continue to enjoy exclusive early access, as promised from the start. You’ll be the very first to play the final build before its public launch!
[hr][/hr]💬 A personal note:
I’ve been leading Trasmoz Legends from the very beginning, shaping the gameplay, designing visuals and levels, producing all marketing materials, managing the Kickstarter campaign, and creating the artwork for the physical arcade cabinet and digital storefronts.

Before launching the campaign, I brought in a developer to handle the code, thinking that collaboration would allow me to focus more deeply on design and production.

Unfortunately, things didn’t work out. The project was eventually abandoned on their side, leaving us months behind schedule and with a fragile, amateur codebase that simply couldn’t support the game we were building.

What followed was one of the toughest creative challenges I’ve ever faced: accepting that I had to rebuild nearly everything from scratch, alone.

Systems, mechanics, collisions, transitions, boss logic, controls… much of the game had to be rewritten, refactored, and rebuilt. In some cases, I had to do things twice. But I never gave up.

I’ve been quieter these past months because I was deep in the trenches, pushing through, solving one problem at a time, and holding it all together.

Thankfully, I wasn’t truly alone. Alberto Martínez composed the full soundtrack and stayed by the project through to the end, not just musically, but as a dedicated tester.
Sergio Ferredelo has been my unwavering right hand throughout development, testing, supporting, encouraging, and reminding me why this game mattered.

And when I finally had the PC version nearly complete, Javi, Marc, and Jandu from JanduSoft team stepped in, making the console ports possible and ensuring that, even with almost a year of delay, we’d stay true to the multi-platform vision originally promised during the campaign.

I also want to thank Jacaba and Lolo from El Templo del Arcade, who brought the physical cabinet to life, building the arcade machine of my dreams and giving Trasmoz Legends a real-world presence worthy of the old-school legends.

What you’re playing now is the result of a colossal effort, a game that had to be rebuilt under pressure, but that made it.

I’m incredibly proud of what Trasmoz Legends has become.

And above all, I want to thank every single backer, every player who pre-ordered, and everyone who supported this project along the way.

This game was made for you, and because of you.
I truly hope you enjoy it as much as I enjoyed finishing it for you.

🎮 Trasmoz Legends is finally real.
Complete. Brutal. And 100% arcade.

See you on the leaderboards!
BºRJª / Volcano Bytes

notes.title: Trasmoz Legends v0.04 Dev Update
notes.notes:
Trasmoz Legends V0.04 – New Gameplay Features, Improved Challenge, and Audio Updates


The V0.04 update of Trasmoz Legends is here, packed with exciting new features that will deepen the gameplay experience. In this version, we’re introducing enhanced mechanics, updated graphics, and an even more challenging Endless Mode. 

Along with further control refinements, this update brings new music, improved level designs, and a new multiplier system that will make the adventure more immersive than ever.


💀 New Gameplay Mechanics & Features 💀

Candle Multiplier System: 
A brand-new mechanic where lighting candles in sequence with active orbs increases the multiplier (x2, x3, x4). Players who follow the right order will see a major point boost, and Mutamin will drop more coins while vulnerable if the multiplier is active. This adds a strategic layer for high-score seekers, especially in "Endless mode"!


Score Adjustments for Extra Lives: 
We've balanced the score thresholds for gaining extra lives across the different game modes to create a more refined and fair difficulty progression.


💀 Level Design Enhancements 💀

Full Level Revision: 
All levels have been reworked for better flow and aesthetics, ensuring a more polished and immersive experience for players.


New Intro Graphics for Monster Spawns: 
We’ve added new “graves” that appear when monsters spawn, adding more visual cues to gameplay at the start of each level.


💀 Gameplay Improvements 💀

Warping System Improvements: 
The warping system (moving from one side of the screen to the other by crossing the screen edge) has been refactored and improved to prevent player deaths outside the screen.


Sword Dash Adjustments: 
Based on community feedback, we’ve improved the sword dash for better combat fluidity, making it more intuitive for fast-paced action.


Refined Coyote Jump: 
This mechanic has been improved to make jumping at platform edges more reliable, ensuring smoother navigation through the levels.


Armor Pickup Bug Fix: 
We fixed a visual bug where picking up armor displayed the character incorrectly for a few seconds. 

Additionally, the chest reward system has been revamped. Now, if you collect a chest without armor, you get armor. If you’re already wearing armor, you’ll receive points instead.


Double Air Attack Bug Fix: 
Addressed an issue where players could attack twice while airborne. Now, the air attack works as intended.


💀 Endless Mode Enhancements 💀

Incremental Difficulty: 
Endless Mode now progressively ramps up the difficulty, ensuring that even the most skilled players will face new challenges as they advance.


💀 Control Refinements 💀


While controls were improved in the previous version, we’ve made additional tweaks, particularly with the jump mechanic. These changes aim to enhance responsiveness, making character control feel more intuitive and precise.


💀 Audio & Visual Updates 💀

New Music and Sound Effects: 
We’ve added new music and sound effects to enhance the atmosphere of Trasmoz Legends. Additionally, we’ve fixed a few audio loops that weren’t playing correctly, and we've applied compression techniques to reduce file sizes and improve performance without sacrificing quality.


Graphical Updates for Mode Selector: WIP 
We’ve revamped the mode selector’s look to make navigating between game modes smoother and more visually appealing.


🔜 What’s Coming Next? WIP V0.05!
* 6 more levels for Endless Mode.
* Final results screens, attract mode, stage headers, and game transitions.
* Introduction of global rankings and Steam achievements.
* Final polishing of Pixel Art, Vfx, Sfx, and music.
* Final screen selection for Family and Classic mode.
* Ongoing game testing and balancing across all modes.

💀 Join the Fight! 💀


This is a key moment in the development process, and your input is incredibly important as we fine-tune the final details of the game.


If you were a Kickstarter backer and are enjoying early access, we encourage you to explore the latest version, enjoy the new updates, and share your feedback with us.


Your feedback will help shape the final version of the game as we move closer to the official launch.


Your feedback can make a big difference. Don’t hesitate to share your thoughts!


Thank you once again for your support. See you in the game!


BºRJª

notes.title: Trasmoz Legends v0.03 Update
notes.notes:
We're excited to share the latest update of Trasmoz Legends with version v0.03. 

Featuring key performance optimizations and new gameplay additions.

Here's what you can expect:

💀 Performance Overhaul!

One of the most significant improvements in this update is the complete refactor of our gamepad input system.

After identifying that the previous external library consumed nearly 45% of performance, causing stuttering and delayed gamepad responses on medium and low-end devices, we switched to an XInput-only solution.

This transition has dramatically improved the game's performance, making it smoother and more responsive across all systems.

💀 Gameplay Enhancements

* Steam Remote Play is now fully integrated, allowing for seamless cooperative gameplay.

* In-game level indicators for Infinite Mode now help you keep track of your progress during play and on the results screen.

* New selectable bezels to customize your game view, which are accessible through the options menu. (Art still WIP)

* Player control tweaks have been implemented based on community feedback, continuing to refine and improve gameplay responsiveness.

💀 Visual and Audio Updates

* Significant updates to the particle systems and VFX have been made, enhancing performance on low-end devices and paving the way for future console ports. 

This visual overhaul not only boosts game performance but also stays true to the 1984-inspired aesthetic we aim to achieve, delivering a more authentic retro experience.

* Refinement of disappearing platform mechanics, alongside updated SFX and VFX, bringing a more polished and immersive experience.

💀 General Improvements

* Various bug fixes, including typographical errors and a revision of the in-game credits.

* Ongoing work on performance tweaks to further refine the game for future updates.

This update marks another important step in improving Trasmoz Legends as we continue to refine both performance and gameplay. 

We are continuing to work full steam ahead, bringing new features and improvements until the official launch.

To our backers and pre-purchasers currently enjoying VIP early access:

your feedback is incredibly valuable to us. We appreciate all the support you’ve given so far and encourage everyone playing to share their thoughts and feedback. Not only will it not bother us, we love it! 

So please, feel free to contribute and be a part of shaping this retro-inspired arcade classic!

Thank you for being a part of this journey!

BºRJª

notes.title: Trasmoz Legends Update V0.02- Fixes, Enhancements, WIP and What's Next!
notes.notes:
Hello, Champions of Trasmoz!

First and foremost, we want to express our immense gratitude to all our backers who are downloading and playing the early access version of Trasmoz Legends. Your feedback has been incredibly valuable, guiding our development towards what players find most enjoyable. 

We’re eager for you to continue this journey with us. Thank you all for your support!

We are thrilled to share our latest update. Your feedback has been crucial, here’s what we've been working on:

💀 Fixes and Improvements:

Code Refactoring: 

Major optimizations to boost performance and increase FPS, enhancing functionality across the board.

Graphics, VFX, and SFX Updates: 

Enhancing visuals and audio to create a more immersive experience.

Level Revisions: 

New levels added, and previous ones updated with refined gameplay and design.

💀 What We’re Working On Now:

Development of the game's intro, final sequences, and animations for stage headers.

Input System Refinements:
Improved compatibility with various gamepads at better performance, fine-tuning player's controls.

New Result Screens:
Expanded result screens for Easy, Hard, Infinite, and Speedrun modes, with additional end-game bonuses, especially for two-player co-op sessions.

Global Rankings and Achievements: 
Documentation underway for integrating global rankings and Steam achievements in future updates.

Polishing Gameplay: 
Fine-tuning controls, balancing enemy difficulty, and optimizing performance across all levels.

Polishing Graphics: 
Refining animations, intro, area headers, and the ending sequence to ensure everything looks and plays smoothly.

Power-Ups and Abilities: 
Developing a variety of power-ups to enhance gameplay, adding strategic depth to every run.

New Attract Mode: 
Adding retro animations and game instructions in the style of early 80s arcade classics to capture attention and immerse players right from the start.

Expanding Infinite Mode:
Adding new levels, aiming for 20 different levels in the release version to keep players engaged.

Default High Scores & KS Credits:
Finalizing and revising names for high scores, developer credits, backers, and VIP supporters to ensure every contributor and champion of Trasmoz Legends gets recognized in the final version.

Limited Edition Artbook: 
A luxury printed artbook showcasing the artistic journey of Trasmoz Legends and the entire Trasmoz saga. Backers will have the first opportunity to get this collector’s item during the next months.

KS Physical Rewards: 
All physical rewards from the Kickstarter campaign, except for the Artbook, are ready and will start shipping during next months. We’re thrilled to get these items into your hands as a token of our gratitude!

🔧 What’s Next: 

We are diligently working on these updates and more. Your role as backer is essential; your feedback is helping us shape the final version of Trasmoz Legends, aiming for an official release later this year. 

We'll continue to keep you updated! Thank you for being an essential part of this journey!

Best regards,
BºRJª
